cd /workspace && python3 - << 'PY'
import sys,json,subprocess,time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev')
import stress_feas as SF
for sd in [102,100]:
    req=SF.gen(sd,NOBS=64,mode='feasible'); req['id']='big%d'%sd
    data=json.dumps(req)
    t=time.time()
    r=subprocess.run(['/workspace/submission/run.sh'],input=data,text=True,capture_output=True,cwd='/')
    print(sd,'wall %.2f rc %d'%(time.time()-t,r.returncode), json.loads(r.stdout).get('status'), json.loads(r.stdout).get('min_faults'))
PY
